host: reference container (Apple Silicon / aarch64, 4 CPUs, 8 GiB cgroup)
races: one 4-way concurrent race per case, epsilon in {0.125, 0.375, 0.5, 1.0}; caps shuffle_win 100 s, rem12 60 s, m22 30 s
perf: perf record -e cpu-clock on m22 first-outcome (--timeout 30), 14,007 samples; perf report --no-children + perf annotate of Search::evaluate_child
notes: Single race per case: the solver is deterministic per (FEN, config) (plan7 record: ~1% wall spread across 8 rounds), so one race is representative up to machine noise.
Race walls are measured with 4 processes running concurrently; plan7 showed no measurable contention slowdown at 4 racers (P0 in-race 52.2 s vs baseline alone 52.7 s).
